name: Leraje
source:
"Kuku... Good! Get scared even more! Cry and scream!!"
A demon who only acts destructively.
With a cruel personality seeing others suffer brings him pleasure. Even other demons regard him as dangerous.
He thinks of the protagonist as nothing else than another thing to destroy.
